facts.en: Completed a digital media diploma at Fictional Wren College in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构鹪鹩学院完成数字媒体文凭课程。

facts.en: Content upload assistant at Fictional Birch Web Studio, 2021-09 to 2023-12.
facts.zh: 2021-09 至 2023-12 在虚构桦木网页工作室任内容上传助理。

facts.en: Content quality assistant at the same studio, 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在同一工作室任内容质量助理。

facts.en: Checked links, heading order and presence of image descriptions on draft client pages using an internal checklist.
facts.zh: 使用内部核对表检查客户草稿页面的链接、标题顺序及图片说明是否存在。

facts.en: Supported review of 15 pages in 2025-04 with a content editor; the editor approved wording changes.
facts.zh: 2025-04 与内容编辑共同审核 15 个页面；措辞修改由编辑批准。

facts.en: Personally logged 23 missing image descriptions and routed them to page owners; did not judge whether all descriptions were appropriate.
facts.zh: 个人记录 23 项缺失图片说明并转交页面负责人；未判断所有说明是否恰当。

facts.en: By 2025-05, page owners had supplied descriptions for 20 of those 23 items; 3 remained open in the tracker.
facts.zh: 截至 2025-05，页面负责人已为其中 23 项中的 20 项补充说明；跟踪表中仍有 3 项未完成。

facts.en: The checks did not cover all accessibility criteria, assistive technologies or user groups; no full-conformance finding is supported.
facts.zh: 检查未覆盖全部无障碍标准、辅助技术或用户群体；不支持全面符合性的结论。

facts.en: Uses HTML heading tags and a spreadsheet issue log to record content corrections.
facts.zh: 使用 HTML 标题标签及电子表格问题日志记录内容修改。

facts.en: Drafted a keyboard-check guide in 2026-02; it had not been approved or used in client reviews by 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草键盘检查指南；截至 2026-08 尚未获批或用于客户审核。

facts.en: Attended 2 introductory accessibility workshops in 2024; these did not award a professional credential.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加 2 次无障碍入门工作坊；未因此获得专业资格。

facts.en: Tracked version numbers for images and copy, without release approval authority.
facts.zh: 跟踪图片及文案版本号，无发布审批权限。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Paper Garden on Saturdays from 2023-03 to 2023-10 alongside paid work.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2023-10 周六在虚构纸花园做志愿者，与有薪工作同期。

facts.en: Created a volunteer poster using provided text; it was unrelated to the client web reviews.
facts.zh: 使用提供的文字制作志愿活动海报；与客户网页审核无关。

facts.en: Built a personal recipe index in 2022; it was a local class exercise, not a client website.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人食谱索引；属本地课堂练习，并非客户网站。

facts.en: A portfolio draft calls the 15 pages fully accessible; no comprehensive audit supports that wording.
facts.zh: 作品集草稿称 15 个页面完全无障碍；无全面审核支持该措辞。

facts.en: No independent accessibility certification or audit sign-off authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立无障碍认证或审核签署权限。
